falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern match is invalidated because the August 2024 bottom saw no such recovery within 14 days; a breakout above pre-selloff resistance would indicate this is not a bottoming pattern but a V-shaped recovery or false breakdown

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies elevated fear/uncertainty; sustained VIX compression below 14 would prove the fear spike was transient and the market never reached true capitulation, invalidating the bottom call

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve steepens by more than 25 basis points from current levels within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A steepening curve during a supposed bottom would signal bond market rejection of recession/fed-cut pricing that typically accompanies bottoms; this would indicate the macro regime is risk-on growth rather than bottoming, falsifying the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
